body_lead: CHENNAI: As part of Tamil Nadu's push to position itself as a hub for deep-tech innovation, fostering industry-academia collaboration and emerging technologies, the Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology and Digital Services Minister R Kumar visited the innovation ecosystem at the IIT Madras Research Park (IITMRP) and interacted with the stakeholders.
